reviews.title: Just like every other cash grab
reviews.text: If you’re looking to spend $17 opening a chest that will give you the same rewards as the $2 chest look no further. Here at crab life we like to think this temporary piece of negligible gear is worth your permanent real world dollars. Fancy a temporary buff that leaves you tasting buyers regret decades into your life? Go ahead and click buy. We strive on overloading your screen with ad popups, even during battle sequences, to ensure that(at the games quality expense) we supply you with an item that essentially removes gameplay thus getting you to the end quicker, which inevitably won’t be worth the effort or time. And after you’ve made it to the end, you’ll sit there going “why did I spend the time doing this?” “I could have learned a real world skill or trade. Instead of leveling up a game character, I could have leveled up myself. STOP LETTING THIS BE THE STATUS QUO. Games never used to be like this. All you’re doing by playing this game is allowing someone to cause you anxiety without you even knowing that’s what it is. Go outside and breathe what little fresh air the planet has left.
